translationRepairs: At the time, Ju's younger brother Bo, together with Yang Jiong of Huayin, Lu Zhaolin of Fanyang, and Luo Binwang of Yiwu, were famed for their writing. Li Jingxuan, vice director of the Secretariat, prized them highly and was certain they would rise.

At the time, Ju's younger brother Bo, together with Yang Jiong of Huayin, Lu Zhaolin of Fanyang, and Luo Binwang of Yiwu, were famed for their writing. Li Jingxuan, vice minister of personnel, prized them highly and was certain they would rise.
司列少常伯 is the vice minister of personnel (Ministry of Personnel under its Longshuo-era name), not the Secretariat.
Changqian was a nephew of Cen Text.
Changqian was a nephew of Cen Wenben.
文本 here is the personal name of Cen Wenben (岑文本), not the word "text".
Later he pressed his hand to his brow and cried, "A gift from Heaven!"
The empress raised her hand to her brow and cried, "A gift from Heaven!"
後 here is the empress (天后), who was behind the curtain, not "later"; she exclaimed at the cure.

Fearing that Prince Yuangui of Han and other senior princes of high prestige might plot trouble, the empress dowager showered them with honorary ranks such as the Three Excellencies to win their loyalty.

Fearing that Li Yuanjia, Prince of Han and prefect of Ze Prefecture, and other senior princes of high prestige might plot trouble, the empress dowager showered them with honorary ranks such as the Three Excellencies to win their loyalty.
韓王元嘉 is Li Yuanjia, Prince of Han (prefect of Ze), not Li Yuangui (Prince of Huo).
On renzi day Chengqian, Prince of Yongping and Ruizong's eldest son, was named crown prince.
On renzi day Chengqi, Prince of Yongping and Ruizong's eldest son, was named crown prince.
成器 is Li Chengqi, not "Chengqian".
The empress dowager had Secretariat Director Wu Chengsi reply with an imperial letter: "The emperor is in mourning and does not speak; I govern in his place for now.
The empress dowager had Palace Library Director Wu Chengsi reply with an imperial letter: "The emperor is in mourning and does not speak; I govern in his place for now.
秘書監 is the director of the Palace Library, not the Secretariat.
That summer, in the fourth month, Yuan Ying, Prince of Teng—grand preceptor with the honorary rank of Kaifu Yitong Sanqi and military governor of Liang Prefecture—died.
That summer, in the fourth month, Li Yuanying, Prince of Teng—holder of the honorary rank of Kaifu Yitong Sanqi and military governor of Liang Prefecture—died.
滕王元嬰 is Li Yuanying (surname Li), and the text gives him no grand preceptor post.
The Turks Ashina Gutulu and others attacked Shuo Prefecture.
The Turks Ashina Gudulu and others attacked Shuo Prefecture.
阿史那骨篤祿 is romanized Gudulu elsewhere in this chapter.

Earlier, Feng Yuanchang, left assistant director in the Secretariat, had been a man Emperor Gaozong relied on. In his later years Gaozong was often ill; when the ministries reported business, he would say, "I am not well; discuss matters with Yuanchang and report back to me."

Earlier, Feng Yuanchang, left assistant director of the Department of State Affairs, had been a man Emperor Gaozong relied on. In his later years Gaozong was often ill; when the ministries reported business, he would say, "I am not well; discuss matters with Yuanchang and report back to me."
尚書左丞 belongs to the Department of State Affairs (尚書省), not the Secretariat.

The Secretariat was renamed the Wenchang Bureau; the left and right vice directors became the left and right chancellors; and the six bureaus became the six officials of Heaven, Earth, and the Four Seasons.

The Department of State Affairs was renamed the Wenchang Bureau; the left and right vice directors became the left and right chancellors; and the six bureaus became the six officials of Heaven, Earth, and the Four Seasons.
尚書省 is the Department of State Affairs, not the Secretariat.

Her great-great-grandfather Juchang was made grand commandant and Prince Gongsu of Beiping; her great-grandfather Jian, grand commandant and Prince Yikang of Jincheng; her grandfather Hua, grand commandant and Prince Ancheng of Taiyuan; and her father Shiyi, grand preceptor and Prince Ding of Wei.

Her great-great-grandfather Juchang was made grand commandant and Prince Gongsu of Beiping; her great-grandfather Jian, grand commandant and Prince Yikang of Jincheng; her grandfather Hua, grand commandant and Prince Ancheng of Taiyuan; and her father Shihuo, grand preceptor and Prince Ding of Wei.
士擭/士彠 is romanized Shihuo.
Recording officer Sun Xuchu tried to resist and was beheaded as an example; none of the staff dared stir.
Recording officer Sun Chuxing tried to resist and was beheaded as an example; none of the staff dared stir.
孫處行 is romanized Sun Chuxing.
Wu Chengsi and his cousin, Right Guard General Sansi, repeatedly urged the empress dowager to find occasion to execute Princes of Han Yuangjia and Lu Lingqi, whose rank and standing were exalted.

Wu Chengsi and his cousin, Right Guard General Sansi, repeatedly urged the empress dowager to find occasion to execute Li Yuanjia, Prince of Han, and Li Lingkui, Prince of Lu, whose rank and standing were exalted.
韓王元嘉 is Li Yuanjia and 魯王靈夔 is Li Lingkui; the princedoms are Han and Lu.

When Yan was imprisoned, commandant Jiang Zizong arrived in Chang'an on embassy. Liu Ren'gui questioned him about affairs in the Eastern Capital. Zizong said, "I had long noticed that Pei Yan was not himself."

When Yan was imprisoned, commandant Jiang Sizong arrived in Chang'an on embassy. Liu Ren'gui questioned him about affairs in the Eastern Capital. Sizong said, "I had long noticed that Pei Yan was not himself."
姜嗣宗/嗣宗 is romanized Sizong.
姜嗣宗/嗣宗 is romanized Sizong.
姜嗣宗/嗣宗 is romanized Sizong.
The next day he took Ren'gui's memorial and departed. The memorial read: "Zizong knew Pei Yan was plotting rebellion and said nothing."
The next day he took Ren'gui's memorial and departed. The memorial read: "Sizong knew Pei Yan was plotting rebellion and said nothing."
姜嗣宗/嗣宗 is romanized Sizong.
The Empress Dowager read it and ordered Zizong dragged into the palace courtyard and strangled at Duting.
The Empress Dowager read it and ordered Sizong dragged into the palace courtyard and strangled at Duting.
姜嗣宗/嗣宗 is romanized Sizong.
In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, Left Golden Eagle Commander Heichi Changzhi was appointed Grand General of the Jiangnan Circuit to suppress Jingye.
In the eleventh month, on xinhai day, Left Golden Eagle Commander Heichi Changzhi was appointed Grand Commander of the Jiangnan Circuit to suppress Jingye.
江南道大總管 is a grand commander (大總管), not a grand general.
Chengsan Lang of Fuyang, an officer of the Left Leopard Bow Guard, was captured by Jingye.
Cheng Sanlang of Yuyang, an officer of the Left Leopard Bow Guard, was captured by Jingye.
成三朗 is Cheng Sanlang (surname Cheng), and 漁陽 is Yuyang.
They were about to cut off his head when Chengsan Lang shouted, "I am guard officer Chengsan Lang—not General Li!
They were about to cut off his head when Cheng Sanlang shouted, "I am guard officer Cheng Sanlang—not General Li!
成三朗 is Cheng Sanlang (surname Cheng).

On yichou day, Jingye reached the border of Hailing but was stopped by contrary winds. His general Wang Nazxiang cut off the heads of Jingye, Jingyou, and Luo Binwang and came over to the imperial side.

On yichou day, Jingye reached the border of Hailing but was stopped by contrary winds. His general Wang Naxiang cut off the heads of Jingye, Jingyou, and Luo Binwang and came over to the imperial side.
王那相 is romanized Wang Naxiang.
On gengxu day, Qian Weiwei was appointed to serve as Neishi.
On gengxu day, Qian Weidao was appointed to serve as Neishi.
When a demoted court official came to the chief minister to plead his case, Neishi Qian Weiwei said, "This was the empress dowager's decision."
When a demoted court official came to the chief minister to plead his case, Neishi Qian Weidao said, "This was the empress dowager's decision."
When the empress dowager heard of this, in summer, in the fourth month, on bingzi day, she demoted Weiwei to prefect of Qingzhou and promoted Yizhi to Grand Master of Palace Provision.
When the empress dowager heard of this, in summer, in the fourth month, on bingzi day, she demoted Weidao to prefect of Qingzhou and promoted Yizhi to Grand Master of Palace Provision.
On wuchen day, Liu Ren'gui, Duke of Lecheng, posthumously styled Wenxian, Left Chancellor of the Department of Literary Works and Third-Rank Associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace, died.

On wuchen day, Liu Ren'gui, Duke of Lecheng, posthumously styled Wenxian, Left Chancellor of the Wenchang Bureau (Department of State Affairs) and Third-Rank Associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace, died.
文昌左相 is the left chancellor of the Wenchang Bureau, the renamed Department of State Affairs.
In the sixth month, Wei Daibiao, Minister of the Department of Celestial Affairs, was appointed Third-Rank Associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.
In the sixth month, Wei Daijia, Minister of the Department of Celestial Affairs, was appointed Third-Rank Associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.
Daibiao was the elder brother of Wanshi.
Daijia was the elder brother of Wanshi.

That autumn, in the seventh month, on jiyou day, Wei Xuantong, Left Assistant Director of the Department of Literary Works, was appointed Vice Director of the Crane Terrace and Third-Rank Associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.

That autumn, in the seventh month, on jiyou day, Wei Xuantong, Left Assistant Director of the Wenchang Bureau (Department of State Affairs), was appointed Vice Director of the Crane Terrace and Third-Rank Associate of the Phoenix Pavilion and Crane Terrace.
文昌左丞 is the left assistant director of the Wenchang Bureau, the renamed Department of State Affairs.

That winter, in the eleventh month, on guimao day, Wei Daibiao, Minister of the Department of Celestial Affairs, was appointed grand campaign commander of the Yanran Circuit to campaign against the Turks.

That winter, in the eleventh month, on guimao day, Wei Daijia, Minister of the Department of Celestial Affairs, was appointed grand campaign commander of the Yanran Circuit to campaign against the Turks.
Because his family was humble, she had him joined to the clan of Xue Shao, Commandant of the Empress's Consorts, and ordered Shao to treat him as a paternal uncle by marriage.
Because his family was humble, she had him joined to the clan of Xue Shao, Imperial Son-in-law Commandant, and ordered Shao to treat him as a paternal uncle by marriage.
駙馬都尉 is the commandant title held by imperial sons-in-law.

Xing rose in succession to Vice Minister of the Department of Autumn Affairs; Junchen rose to Censor-in-Chief. Together they kept private gangs of several hundred idle men and made secret denunciation their trade.

Xing rose in succession to Vice Minister of the Department of Autumn Affairs; Junchen rose to Vice Censor-in-Chief. Together they kept private gangs of several hundred idle men and made secret denunciation their trade.
御史中丞 is the vice censor-in-chief.

Junchen and Wan Guojun of Luoyang, judicial reviewer of the Ministry of Justice, jointly composed the Classic of Framing in several thousand words, teaching their followers to net the innocent, weave charges of treason, and construct cases with every branch and detail in place.

Junchen and Wan Guojun of Luoyang, judicial reviewer of the Court of Judicial Review, jointly composed the Classic of Framing in several thousand words, teaching their followers to net the innocent, weave charges of treason, and construct cases with every branch and detail in place.
司刑評事 belongs to the Court of Judicial Review (司刑寺, i.e. 大理寺), not the Ministry of Justice.
In the sixth month, on xinwei day, Su Liangsi was made left chancellor and third-rank associate Wei Daizhi was made right chancellor.
In the sixth month, on xinwei day, Su Liangsi was made left chancellor and third-rank associate Wei Daijia was made right chancellor.
That autumn, in the ninth month, on dingwei day, Huseluo, son of Western Turk qaghan Jiwangye, was made general of the Right Jade Talisman Guard and given the Five Nushibi tribes of Jiwangye's line.

That autumn, in the ninth month, on dingwei day, Huseluo, son of Western Turk qaghan Jiwangjue, was made general of the Right Jade Talisman Guard and given the Five Nushibi tribes of Jiwangjue's line.
Turks raided the border. Heichi Changzhi, grand general of the Left Hawkish Yang Guard, met them.
Turks raided the border. Heichi Changzhi, grand general of the Left Golden Eagle Guard, met them.
左鷹揚衛 is the Left Golden Eagle (Yingyang) Guard.
